nodes.label: Research Article Pipeline Fix Plan
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive fix plan for Research/Article pipeline source retrieval and quality cascade failures. Identifies 9 bugs across core/search.py, article_pipeline.py, pipeline.py, api/serializers.py, and domain/preset_registry.py. Phases: A (Source Retrieval Resilience), B (Evidence Gate + Pipeline Integrity), C (Pre-Mortem + Abstract Deduplication + Metrics), D (Timeout + Model Diversity), E (Testing). Estimated 9 hours.
